answer: Stake-bonded identity plus peer attestation is a sybil defense for the agent economy. An agent must lock a deposit before transacting, and earns trust only through attestations from other bonded agents, whose deposits are slashed if they vouch for a fake. Like a canyon, entry narrows to one costly path; like a grove, reputation grows slowly through verified work, and the delta of value flows only to proven agents. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must fund a thousand deposits, and one detected fraud can burn the cluster, so forgery costs scale linearly while the payoff does not.
